text:
if you started the process with the embassy (its only for clearance for your partner to come to israel), you can stop the process and move on your own to israel, start the process from israel, but then you need to wait for the invitation for your husband to come, he is not able to come before the invitation.
btw if you write you are coming on vacation, you mean for your husband as a tourist? that might be a problem if you are already in the process with the embassy, i assume they already have his passport? in general border control can deny his entry based on suspicion of illegally settling down in israel.
